questions.question: Final goods are divided into:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**consumption goods and capital goods.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Final goods:-**

 
 
• These are those goods that are ready for consumption or use by the end consumer.
 
 
 
• **Consumption goods:-**
 
 
• These are those goods that are used for immediate satisfaction of human needs and wants, such as food, clothing, and electronics.
 
 
 
• **Capital goods:-**
 
 
• These are those goods that are used to produce other goods and services, such as machinery and equipment. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raw materials:-**

 
 
• These are those materials that are used to produce goods, while semi-finished goods are those goods that are partially completed but still require further processing to become final goods.
 
 
 
• **Single goods:-**
 
 
• These are those goods that are not composed of multiple parts or components, while composite goods are those goods that are composed of multiple parts or components.

questions.question: Pawl Kut is a thanksgiving festival of which Indian state?
questions.solution:

• **Pawl Kut:-**

 
 
• **It is a thanksgiving festival celebrated by the Mizos, an ethnic group belonging to the state of Mizoram in India.**
 
• It is usually celebrated in the month of February and is a harvest festival that marks the end of the agricultural year.
 
• The festival is characterized by traditional dances, music, and feasting, where people gather to express gratitude for a bountiful harvest and seek blessings for the coming year.
 
• The festival also has religious significance as it involves the offering of prayers to the deity of harvest and fertility, called Pathian.

questions.question: Which of the following is an INCORRECT statement in regard to the meaning of "Union of States" in the indian context?

options.text: Country was divided into different states for administrative convenience.
Indian federation was the result of an agreement by sovereign units to join it.
Enumerates the power of centre and states through various lists.
Federation not being the result of agreement, no state has a right to secede from it.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian federation was the result of an agreement by sovereign units to join it.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **'Union of States':-**

 
 
• **It is mentioned in the Preamble of the Constitution of India, which describes India as a 'sovereign socialist secular democratic republic' that is a 'Union of States'.**
 
• The Union of States structure has several implications for the governance of India:
 
 
• **Division of power: **The Constitution clearly divides power between the central government and the states. The central government has exclusive power over certain subjects, such as defense, foreign affairs, and currency. The states have exclusive power over other subjects, such as public order, education, and health. There is also a concurrent list of subjects, where both the central government and the states have power to legislate.
 
• **Cooperative federalism**: The relationship between the central government and the states is not adversarial but rather cooperative. Both levels of government need to work together to achieve common goals, such as economic development and social welfare.
 
• **Unity in diversity:** India's vast diversity is one of its greatest strengths. The Union of States structure allows for a balance between national unity and regional diversity. Each state has its own unique culture, language, and traditions, but they are all bound together by a common Indian identity.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is correct about the value of money?

i. It is directly related to the price level.

ii. It is not related to the price level.

iii. It is indirectly related to the price level.

options.text: None of the statements are correct

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only iii is correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The value of money is determined by the demand and supply of money in the economy.
 
• The price level is determined by the demand and supply of goods and services in the economy.
 
• Therefore, the value of money and the price level have an indirect relationship.
 
• When the price level increases, the value of money decreases and vice versa.

questions.question: Which vitamin is synthesised in the presence of sunlight in our body?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin D.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin D:-**

 
 
• **It is the vitamin that is synthesized in the presence of sunlight in our body.**
 
• When the skin is exposed to sunlight, a type of cholesterol present in the skin is converted into vitamin D.
 
• Vitamin D is essential for bone health as it helps the body absorb calcium and phosphorus.
 
• Deficiency of vitamin D can lead to rickets in children and osteoporosis in adults.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin B: **

 
 
• There are several types of vitamin B such as B1, B2, B6, B12, etc.
 
• These vitamins are essential for maintaining good health and well-being.
 
• They play a crucial role in the metabolism of energy, red blood cell production, and brain function.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin C: **
 
 
• Also known as ascorbic acid, vitamin C is an antioxidant that helps protect cells from damage caused by free radicals.
 
• It is also important for the growth and repair of tissues in the body.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin A: **
 
 
• This vitamin is important for maintaining good vision, skin health, and immune function.
 
• It is found in animal products such as liver, fish, and eggs, as well as in some plant-based foods like carrots and sweet potatoes.

questions.question: The stabilisation function of the government budget mainly includes.

options.text: intervention to expand or reduce the demand
distribution of income in society in a fair way

questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** intervention to expand or reduce the demand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stabilisation function:-**

 
 
• It is aimed at maintaining economic stability by adjusting the level of aggregate demand in the economy.
 
• The stabilization function of the government budget is a macroeconomic concept that deals with the management of the overall level of economic activity in the economy. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fiscal policy tools:-**

 
 
• These are used by the government to influence the level of aggregate demand in the economy. Expansionary fiscal policy involves increasing government spending, reducing taxes, and increasing borrowing to stimulate economic growth. In contrast, contractionary fiscal policy involves reducing government spending, increasing taxes, and reducing borrowing to slow down economic growth.
 
 
 
• **Allocation of resources:- **
 
 
• It is an important function of the government, which involves the distribution of resources among different sectors of the economy to achieve economic efficiency and equity.
 
 
 
• **Production of public goods:-**
 
 
• It is another important function of the government, which involves the provision of goods and services that are not provided by the private sector, such as national defense, public health, and education.
 
 
 
• **Distribution of income in society:-**
 
 
• It is an important issue that involves the fair distribution of income among different groups in the economy. The government can use taxation and social welfare programs to achieve a fair distribution of income.
